Read-only result: the rank-one cone is now implemented through the separably closed endpoint. The remaining gap is arbitrary-field finite-stage/descent integration, plus replacement of the Challenge statement-file placeholders.

- `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` is non-vacuous: an actual natural classifier `divisor` with `divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma = 𝟙`; [Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducer.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducer.lean:76). `rankOneAbelIso` is proved for any inhabitant at [Pic0RankOneAbelInverse.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneAbelInverse.lean:181).
- The canonical inhabitant is constructed, with an arbitrary-test natural section, at [Pic0RankOneCanonicalEvaluation.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneCanonicalEvaluation.lean:250); hence `canonicalRankOneAbelIso` is a real definition at line 259.
- `PicRankOneOpen` quantifies over every affine pullback, not fixed P1 charts: [Pic0RankOneLocus.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:46). Its family-level `FibrePresented` producer proves relative openness at [Pic0RankOneOpenProducer.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneOpenProducer.lean:262) and [line 351](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0RankOneOpenProducer.lean:351).
- This gives the actual divisor open, via a carrier equality rather than a logical-open coercion: [DivRankOneOpen.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/DivRankOneOpen.lean:172).

The separably closed endpoint is also real:

- `pic0_sepClosed_representableBy : Σ J, RepresentableBy` at [Pic0SepClosedRepresentable.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SepClosedRepresentable.lean:426), requiring `[IsSepClosed k]`.
- It packages as `PicRepDatum k k C` and then `JacobianData C` at [Pic0SepClosedJacobianData.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SepClosedJacobianData.lean:138) and [line 146](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SepClosedJacobianData.lean:146). The data structures themselves are honest: [PicRepDatum.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicRepDatum.lean:89), [JacobianData.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/JacobianData.lean:87).

**Remaining cone, in priority order**

1. There is no declaration named `pic0_representableBy`; it is explicitly identified as missing, together with arbitrary-base `JacobianData`, at [Pic0CriticalPath.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0CriticalPath.lean:149).

2. Prove the finite-stage spread of the separably closed representative and its universal datum. The key unproved analytic input is only a Prop, not a theorem/instance:
   `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit C`, quantified over cofiltered qcqs affine-transition test diagrams, at [PicRepColimitCompat.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicRepColimitCompat.lean:136). Its residual status is explicit at [PicRepColimitMountain.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicRepColimitMountain.lean:212).

3. Produce the explicit orbit condition for the descended finite-stage semilinear action. Existing descent only proves
   `RepresentableBy` under `[FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [OrbitsInAffineOpen]`, with a supplied finite-level `rep`, at [Pic0FiniteGaloisRepresentable.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0FiniteGaloisRepresentable.lean:35). It does not manufacture either `rep` or the orbit hypothesis.

4. Carry locally-finite-type and quasi-compactness through that descent, then construct `PicRepDatum k k C` and use the already-complete handoff [JacobianDataFromPicRepDatum.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/JacobianDataFromPicRepDatum.lean:83). The current Galois theorem returns only `RepresentableBy`, so it cannot directly produce `JacobianData`.

5. Rewire the statement file. [Challenge.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Challenge.lean:96) still has `sorry` for `Jacobian`, group/smooth/proper/geometric-irreducible instances, Abel map and universal property (99-170), plus base-change results (260, 271, 284, 296). It does not consume `JacobianData`; this is separate from merely importing the rank-one cone.

Root reachability is source-level: [AlgebraicJacobian.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian.lean:815) imports `Pic0CriticalPath`, while it imports the sorry-backed `Challenge` independently at line 168. `Pic0CriticalPath` includes axiom probes for all ranked endpoints, but `lake env lean AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0CriticalPath.lean` currently fails before elaboration: missing `DivSchemeSeedUnivRes.olean`. Thus root import reachability is present, but current kernel verification of the root is blocked by the missing build artifact.

No `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom` tokens were found in the inspected rank-one, open, separably-closed, datum, or conditional Galois files. The only `Classical.choice` usages select from established nonempty witnesses; I found no false rational-point instance, global smooth-proper quotient, or fixed-chart-only rank-one assumption.
